notes:
Data objects, sub-view "Data objects" of the Use Cases tab (new in CHR-1062; the experiment drawing lacked it, the build has it). Full length 1440×1380.

**Left panel:** search ("Search data objects…"), "7 data objects", one row per object: `data_object` icon, name, field count right-aligned. `+` (`btn-add-object`) = new data object → `usecases-object-dialog` (create mode).

**Main (56px side padding):** header "Data objects" + one-sentence explanation ("Reusable shapes of the data your use cases read and write. Inputs, outputs and before/after cards refer to them by id.") and the primary **New data object** (`btn-new-object` → `usecases-object-dialog`, create mode). Two-column grid of cards (`align-items: start`): name + id (mono), edit pencil (`oc-*-edit`, `chrome-icon-btn sm` → `usecases-object-dialog`, edit mode with Delete), description, then a Field · Type · Example table (mono; a `ref` field shows "ref → <object>", an `enum` its values in the dialog).

Sample objects are Artisign's own model: Persona, Dimension, Data object, Use case, Step, Variant, Mapping.
